q: How do I reset my password?
answer: On the sign-in page, click "Forgot password". We email a reset link that expires after 30 minutes.

q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: The Plus plan costs $4 per month, including unlimited notes and up to 3 devices. Annual billing saves 20%.

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: The Team plan is $8 per user per month, so 5 people would cost $40 per month. Annual billing saves 20%.

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: The free plan allows up to 100 notes. If you need more, the Plus plan offers unlimited notes.

q: Can I get my money back? I bought Plus 10 days ago.
answer: Yes, Plus subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Since you bought it 10 days ago, you're eligible for a refund. Contact support@example.com with your order number to request it.

q: I bought Plus three weeks ago. Can I still get a refund?
answer: Plus subscriptions can be refunded within 14 days of purchase. Since three weeks is beyond that period, a refund is no longer available. If you need further assistance, I can open a support ticket for you.

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: There is no Linux desktop app. Linux users can access Example Notes through any modern web browser.

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: Example Notes requires Android 12 or later, so it doesn't run on Android 11. You can use the web app in any modern browser instead.

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: The web app needs an internet connection to work. The mobile and desktop apps support offline use and sync automatically when reconnected. If you need offline access, consider using those apps instead.

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: Go to Settings > Export to export all notes as PDF. Exports are emailed as a ZIP file.

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, select your note, and click "Restore".

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: SMS codes are not supported for two-factor authentication. We only support authenticator apps. You can enable it in Settings > Security > Two-factor authentication.

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: On the Free plan, the maximum attachment size is 25 MB per file.

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: You keep paid features until the end of your current billing period, so you won't lose Plus immediately. When you cancel today, your Plus plan stays active until the billing cycle ends. After that, your account will downgrade to the Free plan.

q: Where do you store my notes?
answer: Your notes are stored in AWS data centers in the United States, encrypted at rest and in transit.
